constructions.title: Layer counts, solstice day lengths and the sign-flip geometry the hypotheses page computes

layers.aquaculture.is: Features of the national marine aquaculture discharge layer `punkt_havdam_udl.geojson`, as fetched.

layers.dumping.is: Features of the licensed dumping-ground layer `klappladser.geojson`, as fetched.

layers.extraction.is: Features of the raw-material extraction layer `raastofomr.geojson`, as fetched.

layers.treatment.is: Features of the treatment-plant discharge layer `punkt_rens_udl.geojson`, as fetched.

daylight.lat.is: The latitude the day lengths are computed at: a round value in the middle of Danish waters, chosen in `DAYLIGHT` in `scripts/hypotheses.py`.

daylight.lon.is: The longitude used with it, chosen the same way.

daylight.shortest_h.is: Hours from sunrise to sunset on the shorter of the solstice days in `daylight.days`, from `sun_events()` in `scripts/daylight.py`.

daylight.longest_h.is: Hours from sunrise to sunset on the longer of those days, computed the same way.

sign_flips.stations.is: Distinct stations among the rows `docs/data/areas/flags.json` flags `batch_sign_flip`.

sign_flips.water_bodies.is: Distinct water bodies those stations fall in, by `docs/data/areas/station_waterbody_overlay.json`.

sign_flips.prefixes.is: Distinct leading prefixes of those station numbers, of the length `_sign_flips()` in `scripts/hypotheses.py` takes.

sign_flips.km_min.is: The shortest great-circle distance between two of those stations, from their positions in `docs/data/areas/stations_series.json`.

constructions.what: Facts the hypotheses page and its data page state about the national layers, the length of the day at the solstices, and the flagged sign-flip stations.
constructions.model: `load_values()` in `scripts/hypotheses.py` counts the features of each layer named in `LAYERS`, reading each small layer whole; asks `sun_events()` in `scripts/daylight.py` for sunrise and sunset on each day in `DAYLIGHT` at its latitude and longitude; and, for the stations `flags.json` flags as a batch sign flip, counts their water bodies and prefixes and the great-circle distances between their series positions.
assumptions: One feature is one site, ground, area or plant.
Sunrise and sunset are where the centre of the sun crosses the geometric horizon, as `sun_events()` finds them; refraction is not applied.
A station's series position is where its samples were taken.

justified.text: The counts are of the fetched layers' features, read whole.
The day lengths come from the project's own solar code, the one that places samples against the sun.
The stations are the ones the flag record names; the record itself is the evidence for the flag.

gaps: Nothing checks whether one physical site appears as more than one feature.
What a station-number prefix encodes is not verified: the flag record calls them custodians.
void_if: a layer is refetched, or the flag record changes, and the page is not rebuilt
constructions.licenses: How many features each layer holds, how long the solstice days are at that latitude, and how the flagged stations are spread.
constructions.not_licensed: That the flagged stations share a custodian, or that every licensed site is in use.

confirmed.by: fork w2-hyp (written against _layer_counts(), _daylight() and _sign_flips() in hypotheses.py and sun_events() in daylight.py; the counts match the fetched layers' features and the day lengths and distances were recomputed by hand. 2026-09-11; not yet read by the project owner)
